Asha (People Ops): Quick heads-up — Lucy Chen is offboarding. Last day 2026-04-01. Need a plan for access freeze, equipment return, COBRA/benefits timing, and 401k questions. Listing items so we can assign owners.
Devon (IT): Got it. Proposing staged deprovision: SSO freeze 09:00 UTC on 2026-04-01, badge disable at same time, laptop wipe courier pickup, org GitHub removal 09:10, revoke SSH keys. Who owns AWS/IAM?
Liam (Infra): I'll own AWS/IAM. I'll rotate IAM keys and remove cross-account roles by 09:05. Which S3 buckets should I treat as sensitive? s3://rdw-customer-logs is on my radar.
Carmen (Benefits): COBRA packet is drafted. To confirm: benefits coverage ends at EOD of last day (2026-04-01). We'll send the COBRA election packet via HR portal within 14 days; employee has 60-day election window per carrier. I'll schedule the outbound email.
Asha (People Ops): Thanks — please schedule COBRA email for 2026-04-02 10:00am and cc People Ops. Also need confirmation on health carrier cutoff and any dependent notices.
Carmen (Benefits): Confirmed. Carrier cutoff = 2026-04-01 EOD. I'll include dependent info and COBRA enrollment link.
Devon (IT): IT checklist: badge, Okta, Slack, Zoom license, GitHub org, Google Workspace, Jira. I'll do a soft freeze so Lucy can still publish notes until 09:00, then full deprovision. Flag if anyone needs a short exception window.
Lucy Chen: Happy to help with handover — I'll leave runbooks and short docs in the offboard doc and be available for quick syncs before 09:00.
Asha (People Ops): Please drop the runbook link here (or DM if private). Also need payroll/401k timing: when is last deferral processed?
Priya (Payroll): 401(k) cutoff aligns with payroll run: last deferral will be processed on payroll dated 2026-03-31. We'll email rollover vendor options; distribution paperwork needs signature — processing ~2–3 weeks.
offboard-bot: scheduled deprovision job created: job_id=ob-2362106789-1 run_at=2026-04-01T09:00:00Z
Devon (IT): Posting commands for reference: `git org remove-user lucy.chen` and `aws iam detach-user-policy --user-name lucy.chen --policy-arn arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/LEAST-PRIV` — I'll run these at 09:00 after confirming no active sessions.
Liam (Infra): I'll snapshot Lucy-owned S3 objects for legal/retention: `aws s3 sync s3://rdw-customer-logs/lucy-archive /tmp/lucy-archive-snapshot` and tag for legal-hold if requested.
Asha (People Ops): Final checklist items: exit interview invite (sending), badge return label (created), equipment pickup scheduled (FedEx label), final paycheck verification, benefits packet sent, and Slack deprovision. @Lucy please confirm preferred shipping address for the laptop label.
Lucy Chen: Address DM'd to Asha. I'll be onsite Tue morning for physical handoff. Fine with a 30-min exit interview slot next Friday.
Devon (IT): Noting Zoom license revoke and GSuite suspend at 09:00. If anyone needs a copy of Lucy's shared calendars, export by 08:50.
Carmen (Benefits): I'll prepare the COBRA packet and cc People Ops + employee. Will include step-by-step to enroll and example premiums.
Priya (Payroll): I'll confirm final paycheck amount and send paystub to Lucy once processed. Also note any outstanding expense reimbursements need to be submitted by 2026-03-28 to make final run.
Asha (People Ops): Thanks team — I'll update the offboard tracker and mark owners. Please post updates here once tasks complete. :handshake:
Devon (IT): Completed initial snapshot and queued deprovision job. Will report back post-run. :white_check_mark:
Liam (Infra): AWS removals scheduled and S3 snapshot done.
Asha (People Ops): Closing note — remember to log keeps for any legal hold exceptions. I'll follow up if anything unexpected pops up.
